BtErr_t HxBtSilentPair ( bool_t  bEnable  ) 

Enables / Disables silent pairing for the system. Calling this function with bEnable set to true will cause the system pairing dialog to be disabled. It will be the responsibility of the caller to manage all pairing messages generated by the Bluetooth stack. Bluetooth message listeners should be setup prior to enabling silent pairing and torn down after exiting silent pairing mode.

It is the responsibility of the caller to exit silent pair mode.

Parameters:
bEnable IN setting for silent pair mode {TRUE, FALSE}
Returns:
BtErrSuccess on success, BtErrNotFound if uuid entry does not exist
